commands.move_tooltip: Move a unit towards a position or follow other units
commands.attack_tooltip: Attack a unit or ground position
commands.areaattack_tooltip: Area attack everything within a circle (click-drag)
commands.manuallaunch_tooltip: Launch a missile at a target
commands.patrol_tooltip: Patrol along one or more waypoints
commands.fight_tooltip: Order units to take action while moving to a position
commands.resurrect_tooltip: Revive wrecks to become units again (click-drag for area)
commands.guard_tooltip: Guard another unit against enemy units attacking it
commands.factoryguard_tooltip: Builders produced by this factory will automatically guard it
commands.wait_tooltip: Pause a unit/factory on processing command/build queues
commands.reclaim_tooltip: Suck metal/energy from wrecks or features (trees/stones)
commands.restore_tooltip: Restore an area of the map to its original height
commands.capture_tooltip: Convert units that belong to the enemy (or ally)
commands.settarget_tooltip: Set a prioritized target (prioritizes targeting when target in range)
commands.areamex_tooltip: Click-drag an area to auto queue metal extractors for all available metal spots
commands.loadunits_tooltip: Load unit or multiple units within an area in the transport
commands.unloadunits_tooltip: Unload unit or multiple units within an area in the transport
commands.stopproduction_tooltip: Clear build queue and quotas for all units on selected factories
commands.morph_tooltip: Upgrade to next Tech-level (second click to cancel)
commands.sellunit_tooltip: Toggle currently selected units for sale, allies will be able to buy them
commands.firestate_defend_descr: Fire upon enemies when they individually become a threat
commands.firestate_fire_at_all_descr: Fire upon anything belonging to the enemy within range
commands.firestate_tooltip: Set under what conditions a unit should start firing at enemies (without explicit attack order).
commands.movestate_tooltip: Set how far out of its way a unit should move to attack enemies
commands.bomber_targeting_tooltip: Hold Fire: Only attack with an explicit order. Fire at will: Idle bombers will seek targets within range.
commands.priority_tooltip: Assigns resources to use for this builder when not having enough for all
commands.onoff_tooltip: Active state: turn a unit on/off
commands.idlemode_tooltip: Sets what aircraft do when idle
commands.aplandat_tooltip: Sets what aircraft do when leaving air factory
commands.csspawning_tooltip: Sets the spawning state of the carrier
commands.trajectory_toggle_tooltip: Switch artillery firing angle between low, high and automatic trajectory
commands.hound_weapon_toggle_tooltip: Sets weapon to a slow plasma projectile with a large aoe, or a fast projectile gauss weapon
commands.blueprint_create_tooltip: Save the selected units into a new blueprint, in the order they were selected
commands.factoryqueuemode_tooltip:
Queue: Build each queued unit once
Quota: Maintain a minimum quota of each unit on the battlefield

customOnOff.trajectory_tooltip: Switch artillery firing angle between low and high trajectory
customOnOff.gauss_tooltip: Switches between Gauss Cannon and Heavy Plasma Cannon

massSelect.sameType: Select all units of same type as selected
massSelect.sameTypeVisible: Select same type as current, on screen

queues.prepend: Add order to start of order queue

controlGroups.focus: Select control group %{n} and focus camera
controlGroups.removeOne: Remove closest unit from its group

camera.cycleSelectedNext: Cycle camera to next selected unit
camera.cycleSelectedPrev: Cycle camera to previous selected unit
